review_basis: The canonical Atlas definitions identify these measures as county-level 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey percentages. No governed current-290 constituency or 1,450-ward survey-domain series is materialised in the Atlas. Parent county survey percentages must not be inherited, proportionally allocated, or treated as local estimates without a published child-domain design and compatible weighting.

indicators.canonical_definition: Share of individuals aged 3 years and above who used the internet in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.
indicators.reason: The governed source is a county-level household survey series. No compatible official constituency or ward domain estimate is present in the canonical registry; copying or downscaling the county percentage would create unsupported local precision.

indicators.canonical_definition: Share of individuals aged 3 years and above who used a computer in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.
indicators.reason: The governed source is a county-level household survey series. No compatible official constituency or ward domain estimate is present in the canonical registry; parent survey percentages cannot be inherited or naively reweighted.

indicators.canonical_definition: Share of households connected to electricity on the main grid in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.
indicators.reason: The governed Atlas series is the KNBS county survey percentage. A lower-level value would require an official child-domain estimate with compatible household denominator and weighting; county percentages cannot be allocated to constituencies or wards.
